The organ that pumps blood is the heart.

Accessibility Audit:
The provided text describes a significant accessibility barrier. Presenting critical information, such as real-time bus and train schedules, solely in a graphical format without accompanying text descriptions violates accessibility standards (such as WCAG). Screen readers cannot interpret images or graphics, rendering the information inaccessible to individuals who are blind or have low vision. To improve accessibility, the text descriptions (alt text) should be added to the graphics, or the schedule information should be provided in a text-based format that is compatible with assistive technologies.
